lessons_used: Interactive walkthrough redesigns on the finish stage significantly hurt completion rates.
Reordering steps (like deferring sign-in) had no clear effect on conversion.
Adding copy estimates and wait-time info showed no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently too high across all test types, anticipating positive gains where results were neutral or negative.

candidates.title: Account Sign-In Session Reassurance
candidates.change: Adds explicit hint copy on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in preserves pet save data across re-installs.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited pets missing or resetting after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in secures your pets so they never get lost or reset when switching devices.

guard.reason: Adds sign-in persistence hint copy within onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: High support volume (8 emails) addressing data loss fear at sign-in step.

candidates.title: Pet Customization Photo Upload Guidance Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the upload photos screen to a split layout with explicit framing instructions to prevent generation errors.
candidates.why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Use well-lit photos with clear faces for the best 3D pet rendering result.

guard.reason: Redesigns photo upload screen layout with framing guidance.

candidates.score_note: Addresses highest funnel leak (39.1% drop) and specific photo generation errors.

candidates.title: Path Selection Choice Cards Layout
candidates.change: Changes the choose_path screen layout to card view to clearly highlight path options.
candidates.why: The choose_path screen takes a mean time of 514s (median 8s), suggesting decision latency for some users.

guard.reason: Updates path selection layout to card view while preserving screen options.

candidates.score_note: Layout change for choose_path supported only by long completion time.

candidates.title: Simplified Desktop First Spawn Welcome Screen
candidates.change: Redesigns home_intro to a spotlight layout explaining basic pet controls without an interactive tutorial.
candidates.why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% and 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open controls, hide, or interact.

guard.reason: Redesigns home intro onboarding overlay screen within allowed limits.

candidates.score_note: Finish redesigns previously resulted in severe negative lift (-31.0%).

candidates.title: Pet Generation Mascot Progress Flow
candidates.change: Replaces the waiting screen status element with a animated companion mascot while pet generation completes.
candidates.why: The home stage waiting step has a long mean duration (2336s) and 81.3% conversion.

guard.reason: replacement for 'waiting.wait_status' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['preview', 'progress', 'timer']

candidates.title: Adoption Path Pet Selection Screen Grid Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the pick_friend screen using a grid layout with feature badges for easier browsing.
candidates.why: Adoption is the biggest funnel leak at 60.9% conversion and 1017s mean time.

guard.reason: Redesigns pet selection screen grid layout while retaining choice functionality.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest drop step with layout tweak, though lacks support ticket evidence.

candidates.title: Sign-In Error Prevention Headline
candidates.change: Updates sign-in screen headline and hint to clarify sign-in persistence and reduce drop-offs.
candidates.why: 2 support tickets reported sign-in stalling or screens failing to appear, and sign_in conversion is 72.9%.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Pet
sign_in.hint: Having trouble? Signing in connects your account and preserves your pet memory.

guard.reason: Updates sign-in headline and hint text within onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy update addressing sign-in persistence and 2 support tickets.

candidates.title: Story Screen Mascot Centered Layout
candidates.change: Updates the initial story screen to a centered layout featuring an encouraging mascot component.
candidates.why: First step drop-off is 23.8% (choose_path conversion is 76.2%).

guard.reason: Redesigns story screen layout with a mascot while preserving pet introduction.

candidates.score_note: Minor visual update to step 1 with minimal expected impact.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Quick Overview Screen
candidates.change: Adds a static introduction screen before home_intro summarizing mouse clicks and desktop drag controls.
candidates.why: 3 support emails specifically noted post-onboarding confusion regarding controlling or hiding the pet.

new_quick_start.headline: Desktop Pet Basics
new_quick_start.body: Click and drag to move your pet around your desktop. Right-click for options.

guard.reason: Adds a new quick start overview screen inside onboarding without removing required steps.

candidates.score_note: Solves reported post-onboarding confusion but requires adding a new screen.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Naming Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Adds a supportive naming hint and badge on the adoption certificate screen to encourage rapid completion.
candidates.why: Adoption has the highest friction in the onboarding flow (60.9% conversion).

adoption_certificate.hint: Give your new pet a name to make it official!

guard.reason: Adds naming guidance hint and badge to adoption certificate screen.

candidates.score_note: Easy hint configuration change on the step with lowest conversion.

picked: Pet Customization Photo Upload Guidance Redesign
Simplified Desktop First Spawn Welcome Screen

decisions.title: Pet Customization Photo Upload Guidance Redesign
Simplified Desktop First Spawn Welcome Screen

lessons_next: Layout changes to choice cards were helpful and significantly improved conversion.
Interactive walkthrough redesigns on the finish stage and sign-in reassurance hints significantly hurt conversion.
Reordering steps, adding copy estimates, wait-time info, and photo upload guidance showed no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently too high for walkthroughs, hints, reordering, and copy changes, anticipating positive gains where results were neutral or negative.
Predictions were too low for layout changes, underestimating the actual positive impact.
